llm_response.reason: The website claims to be a global, legally registered cryptocurrency exchange headquartered in the US with offices in several countries and millions of users, yet WHOIS data shows it was registered only days ago in 2025. There are promises of zero transaction fees, guaranteed deposit protection, massive trading capacity, and ambiguous company information with unverifiable credentials. The support email address is nonstandard and the privacy statement is opaque. There are no verifiable external links or regulatory certifications. All these match multiple scam characteristics, especially for cryptocurrency investment scams.
